events.text: Past midnight, a crash downstairs: four masked robbers are prying open the strongbox of your business.

choices.text: Go down and stop them

ok.log: Two run, two are carried to the magistrate. The whole street hears that your business is not an easy mark.

fail.log: There are more of them than you thought. They leave bruised, and so do you, with the night's takings. (−60 taels)

choices.text: Stay hidden and let them take the box

effects.log: They take the strongbox and leave the ledgers. Silver can be earned again. (−80 taels)

events.text: A cart carrying your goods to market is stopped on the road by bandits. The driver runs back to you, white-faced.

choices.text: Ride out after them

ok.log: You catch them at the ford. The goods come home; the bandits do not want to talk about it.

fail.log: They know the hills better than you do. The goods are gone. (−50 taels)

choices.text: Pay the driver well and write off the cargo

effects.log: The driver is grateful, and tells everyone you are a fair employer. (−40 taels)

events.text: A merchant opens the same kind of business across the street from yours, with a bigger sign and lower prices.

choices.text: Win the customers back with better service

ok.log: Within a season, the regulars are back. The new sign is taken down by winter.

fail.log: The cheaper prices win this year. Your takings fall.

choices.text: Lower your prices to match

effects.log: A price war. Both of you lose silver this year, but you keep your customers.

choices.text: Offer to buy the rival out

effects.log: The merchant takes your silver and moves to another city. The street is yours again. (−120 taels)

events.text: Someone is spreading a rumour that your business cheats its customers. The trail leads to a rival merchant guild.

choices.text: Find proof and shame them in public

ok.log: You find the paid gossip and their paymaster. The guild apologises in front of the whole market.

fail.log: You cannot prove it. The rumour lingers for a season.

choices.text: Ignore it and let your work speak

effects.log: Some customers stay away for a while. Most come back.

events.text: A county inspector walks through your business, frowning at everything, and finally says the paperwork has "problems". A small gift would solve them.

choices.text: Pay the bribe

effects.log: The problems vanish with the silver. The inspector will be back next year. (−50 taels)

choices.text: Refuse, and show every page of your books

ok.log: Your books are perfect. The inspector leaves with nothing but a sour face.

fail.log: The inspector finds a missing seal and fines you properly. (−90 taels)

choices.text: Report the inspector to the magistrate

effects.log: The magistrate thanks you, and the inspector is moved to a distant county. Some officials now dislike your name.

events.text: Three men in black and red robes sit down in your business and order nothing. Their leader explains that the Demonic Cult protects shops on this street, for a monthly fee.

choices.text: Pay the protection money

effects.log: They leave with the silver and a bowl of your best, unpaid for. (−70 taels)

choices.text: Throw them out

ok.log: They leave through the door, not quite on their feet. The street is grateful. The Cult will remember.

fail.deathCause: the Demonic Cult, over a shopfront
fail.log: They beat you badly and break half the furniture on the way out. Business is slow for the rest of the year.

choices.text: Ask the orthodox sects for help

effects.log: A disciple of a righteous sect sits by your door for a month. The Cult goes elsewhere, for now. (−30 taels)

choices.text: Bow low and say the shop cannot pay

effects.log: They look around your empty tables, take a jar of wine for their trouble, and promise to come back next month. The whole street watched you bow.

events.text: The men in black and red robes are back, more of them this time, and they are not here to talk about fees.

choices.text: Stand at the door and fight

ok.log: You hold the door. By morning the whole county knows the Cult lost a fight to a shopkeeper.

fail.deathCause: a Demonic Cult raid on your business
fail.log: They break in and wreck the place. You survive; the year's takings do not.

choices.text: Close for a season and wait for them to lose interest

effects.log: You lose a season of business, but nobody is hurt.

events.text: A famous wandering swordmaster walks into your business, sits by the window and stays all afternoon. People gather outside just to look.

choices.text: Serve them yourself, and refuse payment

effects.log: The swordmaster nods once and leaves a line of calligraphy on your wall. Customers come from three counties to see it.

choices.text: Ask for a lesson in exchange

ok.log: An amused hour in the back courtyard. You learn more than you expected.

fail.log: The swordmaster laughs and says no, kindly. They still pay double.

events.text: A celebrated poet spends a rainy week at your business and writes a poem about it that the whole province is soon reciting.

choices.text: Hang the poem above the door

effects.log: Your business is in a poem now. Strangers arrive asking for the table by the window.

choices.text: Ask the poet to write one about the owner instead

effects.log: The poem about you is shorter, kinder and a little too honest. People still come to see who it is about.

events.text: Fire! A lamp tipped in the night, and flames are climbing the back wall of your business.

choices.text: Run into the smoke to save what you can

ok.log: You come out coughing, with the ledgers and the strongbox. The building will be rebuilt.

fail.deathCause: a fire at your own business
fail.log: The smoke is worse than the fire. Neighbours pull you out. The building is half gone.

choices.text: Organise the street into a bucket line

effects.log: The whole street turns out. The building is saved, though not the year's profits. The neighbours remember who led them.

events.text: A week of heavy rain floods the storeroom of your business. Half the stock is ruined.

choices.text: Throw it out and restock at once

effects.log: New stock costs silver, but the shelves are full again before the rain ends. (−60 taels)

choices.text: Sell the damaged goods cheap

effects.log: Bargain hunters clear the storeroom. You lose a little silver and a little reputation.

choices.text: Dry what you can with your own hands

effects.log: Three days of carrying wet sacks into the sun. You save a third of it and lose your customers' patience.

events.text: An officer of the provincial army arrives with a sealed letter: the army needs supplies for a winter campaign, and your business is large enough to provide them.

choices.text: Accept, and deliver everything on time

ok.log: Every cart arrives on the day promised. The army pays in full, and asks for you by name next time. (+600 taels)

fail.log: Half the carts are late in the snow. The army pays, but much less. (+250 taels)

choices.text: Accept, but charge the army double

effects.log: The quartermaster pays without blinking. Somewhere a soldier eats a little less this winter. (+700 taels)

choices.text: Decline: the army's business brings the army's enemies

effects.log: The officer leaves, offended. Your business stays out of the war.

events.text: Your manager has vanished in the night, along with the strongbox, the best stock and the ledgers that would show how long it has been going on.

choices.text: Track them down

ok.log: You find them at an inn two towns away, counting your silver. Most of it comes home. They do not.

fail.log: The trail goes cold at the river. The silver is gone. (−150 taels)

choices.text: Let them go and learn from it

effects.log: You write off the loss and start again. Next time you will choose more carefully. (−120 taels)

events.text: A night with the ledgers by lamplight. The numbers are almost right, but not quite, and the difference has a shape.

choices.text: Follow the numbers

ok.log: A supplier has been overcharging you for years. The silver comes back, with an apology. (+60 taels)

fail.log: By dawn your eyes ache and the numbers still do not explain themselves.

choices.text: Close the book and sleep

effects.log: Some mysteries are cheaper to leave alone.

events.text: An old employee of your business asks for a moment. A rival offered them double wages to leave, and they want you to know they said no.

choices.text: Raise their wages anyway

effects.log: They go back to work with a straight back. The others notice. (−30 taels)

choices.text: Thank them warmly

effects.log: They were not asking for silver. Being thanked was enough.

events.text: A letter from your branch in another city: business is good, the staff are honest, and could you please visit one day?

choices.text: Travel to visit them

effects.log: The branch staff throw a dinner in your honour. You come home with ideas and a sore stomach.

choices.text: Send a gift instead

effects.log: A crate of good wine goes south. The branch writes back twice as warmly. (−20 taels)

events.text: An old teahouse owner wants to retire to the countryside and asks if you would buy the teahouse, regulars, go boards and all.

choices.text: Buy it (660 taels)

effects.log: You sign the deed and take the keys. (−660 taels)

choices.text: Wish them well and say no

effects.log: They find another buyer by spring.

events.text: The widowed owner of a busy roadside inn is tired of the work and offers to sell it to someone they trust.

choices.text: Buy it (1100 taels)

effects.log: You sign the deed and take the keys. (−1100 taels)

choices.text: Wish them well and say no

effects.log: They find another buyer by spring.

events.text: A pawnbroker with no heirs offers to sell you the shop, the counter, the ledgers and every unclaimed sword in the back room.

choices.text: Buy it (880 taels)

effects.log: You sign the deed and take the keys. (−880 taels)

choices.text: Wish them well and say no

effects.log: They find another buyer by spring.

events.text: An elderly pharmacist, too frail for the drawers and scales, offers to sell you the pharmacy and its recipes.

choices.text: Buy it (1320 taels)

effects.log: You sign the deed and take the keys. (−1320 taels)

choices.text: Wish them well and say no

effects.log: They find another buyer by spring.

events.text: A smith with a bad shoulder offers to sell you the forge, the anvils and the apprentices who come with them.

choices.text: Buy it (1540 taels)

effects.log: You sign the deed and take the keys. (−1540 taels)

choices.text: Wish them well and say no

effects.log: They find another buyer by spring.
